en: A black‑and‑white postcard‑style photograph showing two smiling women wearing similar cape-like garments and hats, sitting at a small desk in a cozy room. One woman holds up a small doll or ornament while the other offers a tall, lit candle. On the wall behind them are many pinned papers and several Christmas or winter holiday cards with illustrations. The scene has an intimate, festive, mid‑20th‑century feeling, focused on holiday preparations rather than an outdoor landmark.
